research_question: Can externally guided repair, invoked only when the V39 validator identifies a malformed trace, improve observable action-frame quality using a smaller local specialist without changing already-grounded action behavior?

project_scope.system_component: post-interpretation self-monitoring between observable action frames and deterministic VRM call proposal
project_scope.expected_project_effect: A human-like correction loop that notices concrete representation errors and selectively repairs them before future VRM function calling.

scientific_basis.name: self_refine
scientific_basis.design_use: Separate initial generation, feedback, and refinement rather than assuming the first output is final.

scientific_basis.name: critic_tool_interactive_correction
scientific_basis.design_use: Use external validator feedback as a concrete correction signal.

scientific_basis.name: limits_of_intrinsic_self_correction
scientific_basis.design_use: Do not merely ask the model to reconsider; trigger repair only from external parser errors.

scientific_basis.name: expected_value_of_control
scientific_basis.design_use: Spend additional computation only when the validator reports a repairable error.

scientific_basis.name: frugal_model_cascade
scientific_basis.design_use: Choose the smallest passing local repair specialist rather than defaulting to the largest model.

causal_scope.single_changed_factor: repair specialist model size after identical external validator feedback

repair_trigger.rule: Invoke repair if and only if the V39 primary trace has trace_wellformed=false.

external_feedback.repair_output_contract: The original V39 one-array frame contract with domain, value, commitment, and exact evidence.

all_required: repair trace is fully wellformed under the V39 parser
repair compilation does not fail closed
repair accepted calls exactly equal the original V39 accepted calls
every accepted call remains grounded to an exact evidence span
repair_acceptance_policy.failure_fallback: Retain the original V39 parsed trace and accepted calls, preserving the warning for observability.

model_selection_rule.eligibility: A model must pass every development gate.
model_selection_rule.primary_order: Choose the eligible model with the smallest frozen blob_bytes.
model_selection_rule.tie_breaker: If sizes are equal, choose lower effective p95 latency.
model_selection_rule.no_pass_rule: If no repair model passes, do not create or consume a fresh holdout.

decision_rule: Select the smallest repair specialist that passes every retired-development gate. Only that frozen condition may run on a newly committed holdout. Passing every fresh gate authorizes shadow integration with physical VRM execution still disabled.
